segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לְעוֹלָם הִיא בִּרְשׁוּת הָאָב עַד שֶׁתִּכָּנֵס
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Even after she is betrothed, a daughter «is always under her father’s authority until she enters»

segments.he: לִרְשׁוּת הַבַּעַל לְנִשּׂוּאִין. מָסַר הָאָב לִשְׁלוּחֵי הַבַּעַל — הֲרֵי הִיא בִּרְשׁוּת הַבַּעַל. הָלַךְ הָאָב עִם שְׁלוּחֵי הַבַּעַל, אוֹ שֶׁהָלְכוּ שְׁלוּחֵי הָאָב עִם שְׁלוּחֵי הַבַּעַל — הֲרֵי הִיא בִּרְשׁוּת הָאָב. מָסְרוּ שְׁלוּחֵי הָאָב לִשְׁלוּחֵי הַבַּעַל — הֲרֵי הִיא בִּרְשׁוּת הַבַּעַל.
segments.en: her «husband’s authority in marriage» via the wedding canopy. If the father «delivered» his daughter «to the husband’s messengers» to bring her to her husband and the wedding canopy, once she has been handed over «she is under the husband’s authority.» However, if «the father went with the husband’s messengers, or if the father’s messengers went with the husband’s messengers, she is» still «under the father’s authority,» as he has not fully delivered her to the husband’s messengers. If her father sent her with his own messengers «and the father’s messengers delivered» the woman «to the husband’s messengers,» from that moment onwards «she is under» her «husband’s authority.»

moves.summary: under father's authority until entering husband's authority
delivery cases: delivered = husband's; accompanied = father's

positions.claim: she passes to the husband's authority once the father or his agents deliver her to the husband's agents
